name: goat-scrapbook
description: Scrapbook Sticker · Наалттай цомог: puts the clips on a cream paper page inside taped Polaroids, turns a person or product into a white-edged cut-out sticker, adds a price circle and handwritten Mongolian notes, with stop-motion hops. Renders a 1080x1920 MP4 for Reels/TikTok.
